proposed.rationale: Original question was already source-correct and substantive; the prior edit (source-audited-article-batch-048) was degenerate, with 1-character garbage in 3 of 4 option text fields and a nonsensical rationale. Restored the original verbatim. Original source rationale: Perimeter = 2 × (20 + 30) = 100 m. Minimum separation = 1/5 × 100 m = 20 m. The 1/5 perimeter rule applies directly. A common trap is to use 1/2 diagonal: diagonal = √(20² + 30²) = √1300 ≈ 36.06 m; 1/2 diagonal ≈ 18 m — close but wrong.
